# Tables for the 54-library test (generated by compile.mjs)

Mac run: 540 of 540 checks. Pixel run: 438 of 648 checks, 37 of 54 libraries chosen in the picker.

Answers: found, not found, unconfirmed (the catalog answered but the app could not tell), unknown (the check failed). The app shows both unconfirmed and unknown as "Couldn't check right now". Times are seconds.
